_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 04 부정사의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 1과 부정사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: It is very ________ of you to help me with my homework.

choices.text: thoughtful
kind
generous
difficult
friendly

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: Dad didn’t ________ me to stay out late.

choices.text: want
allow
make
ask
tell

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 It[it]의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: [[It]] was the happiest day of my life.
Is [[it]] possible to finish this by noon?
[[It]] is kind of you to share your lunch.
[[It]] can be risky to swim in the river alone.
[[It]] is not easy to choose a present for him.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> Sora skipped dessert [[to keep]] her weight.

choices.text: It is helpful for you [[to think]] positively.
My assignment is [[to write]] a book review.
Mina went to the market [[to buy]] some fruit.
My brother promised [[to come]] home early to my mom.
Tim hopes [[to visit]] his grandfather during the winter break.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> He decided [[to apply]] for the contest.

choices.text: [[To swim]] every day is good for your health.
My dad looked for a place [[to park]].
The captain has the right [[to decide]].
The boy looked excited [[to win]] the prize.
We had a plan [[to build]] a treehouse together.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: He thinks that useful to keep a diary every day.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The guards had us to show our tickets at the gate.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The coach ordered her stand in the back line.

questions.point_label: in order to = so that ~ can
questions.prompt: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: She practiced hard in order to win the contest. (so)
→ She practiced hard ________ ________ ________ ________ the contest.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • Her parents didn’t allow her ____(A)____ online games.
• Mina watched her sister ____(B)____ the guitar.

choices.text: to play — practice
play — to practice
play — practice
play — practicing
to play — to practice

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • It was hard ____(A)____ me to memorize that poem.
• It was careless ____(B)____ you to leave the door open.

choices.text: of — of
of — for
for — of
for — for
for — about

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 지호는 나에게 그 프로그램을 설치하는 방법을 가르쳐 주었다.
(taught / install / Jiho / to / how / me / the program)
questions.answer: Jiho taught me how to install the program

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 그 코트는 나에게는 너무 비싸서 살 수가 없었다.
(too / expensive / the coat / to / me / for / buy / was)
questions.answer: The coat was too expensive for me to buy

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 내 남동생은 그 상자를 옮길 만큼 충분히 힘이 세다.
(carry / enough / my brother / the box / is / strong / to)
questions.answer: My brother is strong enough to carry the box

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ I have some important news telling you.
ⓑ Sora and I found a nice café to stay.
ⓒ He was too shocked to say anything.
ⓓ Are there extra cushions for guests to sit on?
ⓔ The writer’s new novel seems being boring.
ⓕ Mina needs someone to help her with her project.

questions.prompt: 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Mina seems to like the plan. = It seems that Mina likes the plan.
The soup is warm enough for us to eat. = The soup is so warm that we can eat it.
Jiho is so tall that he can reach the shelf. = Jiho is tall enough to reach the shelf.
This box is too heavy for the child to lift. = This box is so heavy that the child can lift it.
The words were too faint for my grandfather to read. = The words were so faint that my grandfather could not read them.
